content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197, prior auth missing at time of service. This payer does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer, and the CPT requires prior auth. An appeal was already filed and failed. There is no path to obtain the missing auth, and the balance is entirely patient deductible ($142.35), but a CO-197 denial for missing auth is a provider liability that typically cannot be billed to the patient. No available action can recover payer money here.","action":"write_off"}
